rows.Origin:
Discovered by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 2005).
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 2010 as 'Betty Cuthbert'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend. Soft apricot with darker center. Mild, sweet fragrance. Average diameter 3.25". In large clusters bloom form. Rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Arching, upright. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 47" (120cm). Width: 2' (60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Very vigorous. Disease susceptibility: blackspot resistant, mildew resistant.
rows.Patents:
Australia - Application No: 2010/107 on 20 May 2010 VIEW PBR PATENT
Trade reference: Betty Cuthbert

Application withdrawn on August 8, 2011.
rows.Notes: Named after Olympic runner Betty Cuthbert 1938-2017.

colour: Apricot or apricot blend. Soft apricot with darker center.
